cohort: 70 mothers with twin pregnancies at a tertiary care center in Jaipur, India, over a 4-year period (2015-2019).
finding: Maternal complications during twin pregnancy were mainly preterm labor (25.4%), anemia (26.8%), and hypertension (22.5%), while fetal complications were primarily related to IUGR (11.4%) and cesarean section was the main mode of delivery, significantly associated with hypertension and preterm labor.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the main mode of delivery and was significantly associated with hypertension and preterm labor.
followup_time: Early neonatal period (timeframe not precisely specified)
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of the first twin was 2.12 kg (+/- 0.35 kg) and the second twin was 1.97 kg (+/- 0.30 kg)
